title: 第 714章 尝试第 713章 难缠的金昊
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
第714章尝试
冰璇心里清楚，玄机子此人向来算无遗策，既然他说此人关系飞升之机，那便绝非虚言。
可她心底那缕好奇却怎么也压不下去，极阴本源、通天灵宝让她怎么能不动心。
她收回目光，语气冷淡：“希望真如你推算的一样。”
玄机子眼角微不可察地跳了一下，目光深邃地望向远方，没有多说。
经过一个月的休养，陆行舟将伤势尽数恢复，体内灵力也重回巅峰状态。
他缓缓吐出一口浊气，睁开双眼，眼中闪过一丝精光。
陆行舟取出镇灵塔，打出几道法诀，塔身微微震颤，光芒闪烁之间，红色法印和长枪从塔内掉落出来。
这两件都是极品法宝，他都能使用，只是长枪是金发男子本命法宝无法祭炼。
他将长枪收入储物戒中，拿起那枚红色法印，仔细打量了一番。
这法印是一件不可多得的重型法宝，攻防兼备，施展开来如山岳压顶，正好他手中缺少这等重量型的法宝。
他本就有意炼制一件重型法宝，如今有了这枚法印，他可以拿来当作炼制星光印的雏形。
这枚法印材质极佳，以此为基来打造，能省去大半功夫。
而且，他在万毒宗宝库中获得的那枚神秘圆球，其中蕴含的力量极为精纯浑厚，若能融入到这法印之中，必定能让星光印威力更上一层楼。
想到这里，陆行舟不再犹豫，抹去金发男子留在上面的神魂印记，逼出一滴精血，落在红色法印之上，精血瞬间渗入印身，符文亮起一层血光。
他双手掐诀，神识沉入其中，开始祭炼这件法宝，法印嗡鸣震颤，与他逐渐建立一丝联系。
约莫一炷香之后，法印悬浮在他身前，与他心意相通。
陆行舟满意地点了点头，将其收了起来，走出山洞，朝着山上行去。
而此时的火山底下，苏清婉、白寒川和徐景安正深陷苦战，与数只体型庞大的四阶火蜥蜴缠斗不休。
火蜥蜴肉身坚硬无惧高温，擅长穿梭岩浆、隐匿身形，打不过便瞬间沉入岩浆躲避攻势，转瞬又从四面八方突袭而出，使用火刃、坚韧的巨尾疯狂轰击。

这些火蜥蜴的纠缠，让他们根本无法靠近火山核心区域。
徐景安面色焦躁，语气满是怨怼：“妖修果然不靠谱，老祖亲自布置的任务，竟敢懈怠，我看回去他如何向老祖交代。”
此次行动早已规划周全，金昊是重中之重，他体内拥有一缕太阳真火，能抵御狂暴地火，而且他的速度极快，是取宝关键。
他们在火山山顶布下了控火大阵，压制周遭地火威能，便静心等候金昊归来。
可众人一等便是数日，金昊杳无音讯，白寒川接连打出数枚传讯符，尽数石沉大海，没有半点回应。
众人心中骤然不安，以金昊元婴后期的实力，还有各种保命手段，在这秘境之中根本难逢敌手，绝不可能无故失联。
content_en:
Chapter 714 Try
Bingxuan knew in her heart that Xuanjizi had always had a plan, and since he said that this person's relationship had the opportunity to ascend, it was no lie.
But she couldn't suppress the curiosity in her heart. How could she not be tempted by the origin of Jiyin and the Tongtian Lingbao.
She withdrew her gaze and said in a cold tone: "I hope it will be as you expected."
The corners of Xuanjizi's eyes twitched imperceptibly, and he looked deeply into the distance without saying much.
After a month of rest, Lu Xingzhou recovered from all his injuries, and his spiritual power returned to its peak state.
He slowly exhaled a breath, opened his eyes, and a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes.
Lu Xingzhou took out the Spirit-Suppressing Tower and cast a few spells. The tower trembled slightly, and as the light flickered, the red seal and the spear fell out of the tower.
Both of these are top-quality magic weapons that he can use, but the spear is the talisman's magic weapon for the blond man and cannot be refined.
He put the spear into the storage ring, picked up the red seal, and looked at it carefully.
This seal is a rare heavy-duty magic weapon, capable of both offense and defense. It can be used like a mountain pressing against the top of the mountain. It just so happens that he lacks such a heavy-weight magic weapon in his hand.
He had originally intended to refine a heavy magic weapon, and now that he had this seal, he could use it as a prototype for refining the Starlight Seal.
This seal is made of excellent material, and building it based on it can save a lot of effort.
Moreover, the mysterious sphere he obtained in the Ten Thousand Poison Sect's treasure house contains extremely pure and powerful power. If it can be integrated into this seal, it will definitely increase the power of the Star Light Seal to a higher level.
Thinking of this, Lu Xingzhou no longer hesitated, and wiped away the soul mark left by the blond man, forced out a drop of blood essence, and landed on the red seal. The blood essence instantly seeped into the seal, and the runes glowed with a layer of blood.
He made a seal with his hands, his consciousness sank into it, and he began to refine this magic weapon. The seal buzzed and trembled, gradually establishing a connection with him.
After about a stick of incense, the seal floated in front of him, connecting with his mind.
Lu Xingzhou nodded with satisfaction, put it away, walked out of the cave, and headed towards the mountain.
At this time, under the volcano, Su Qingwan, Bai Hanchuan and Xu Jing'an were locked in a fierce battle, fighting endlessly with several huge fourth-order salamanders.
The salamander's body is hard and is not afraid of high temperatures. It is good at traveling through magma and hiding its body. If it cannot be defeated, it will instantly sink into the magma to avoid the attack. In the next moment, it will suddenly rush out from all directions, using the fire blade and the tough giant tail to bombard it wildly.
The entanglement of these salamanders prevented them from getting close to the core area of ​​the volcano.
Xu Jing'an looked anxious and his tone was full of resentment: "The demon cultivator is indeed unreliable. How dare you slack off on the tasks assigned by the ancestor himself? I'll see how he explains to the ancestor when he goes back."
This operation has been well planned, and Jin Hao is the top priority. He has a ray of true sun fire in his body, which can resist the violent earth fire, and his speed is extremely fast, which is the key to obtaining the treasure.
They set up a fire control formation on the top of the volcano to suppress the power of the surrounding earth fire, and then waited patiently for Jin Hao's return.
But everyone waited for several days, and there was no news from Jin Haoyao. Bai Hanchuan fired several communication talismans one after another, but all of them fell into the sea without any response.
Everyone felt suddenly uneasy. With Jin Hao's late-stage Nascent Soul strength and various life-saving means, it was impossible to encounter an opponent in this secret realm, and there was no way he would lose contact without any reason.
